body: @kapunahelewong and @petebacondarwin : The links are no longer in the doc for `CheckAlways` and `CheckOnce`. We can improve this by adding a link to [Change detection](https://angular.io/guide/glossary#change-detection) in the Glossary. Should I go ahead with this?

CheckAlways was removed from the API. There are two places that it needs to be removed from the docs:

* https://angular.io/guide/glossary#change-detection
* https://angular.io/guide/pipes#caching-http-requests

Assigning to @kapunahelewong - as a straightforward docs update.
